rubric.role_summary: Senior food and beverage leadership role overseeing hotel service operations, budgets, staff development, and culinary and beverage delivery across daily service and events.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior food and beverage leadership role overseeing hotel service operations, budgets, staff development, and culinary and beverage delivery across daily service and events.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Proven F&B management experience within hospitality or luxury settings.
- WSET Level 2 or equivalent beverage knowledge.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Strong knowledge of CRM and POS systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Bridport, Dorset, United Kingdom area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
